Syllabus: PTC2620 Computer Integrated Manufacturing
Computer Integrated Manufacturing. Manufacturing Database. Hierarchical control concept. Computer- Aided Design (CAD). Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM). Numerical control. Computer numerical control (CNC). Direct numerical control (DNC). Computer-Aided Process Planning. Robotic Systems. Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC). Statistical Process Control. Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS).
